verdict.rationale: SerpApi is API-first. Its main UI surface, the playground, is a live demo of the same search API. Past searches can also be pulled back through a Searches Archive API, and output formats work across every engine. However, nothing documents API parity for the rest of the UI: account settings, plan and renewal management, ZeroTrace toggling, API key management and usage dashboards. No OpenAPI spec was found either. missing for 10: documented API coverage of account/billing/settings features, explicit parity statement between dashboard and API, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Head to the [playground](/playground?engine=google) for a live and interactive demo.
you'll need to use our Searches Archive API to retrieve your results
Same data as JSON, zero configuration, roughly half the tokens. Works with every API.
